instruction: Increase the contrast of my photo.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully decreased brightness by opening Colors > Brightness-Contrast dialog, setting brightness to -24, confirming with OK, then exporting via File > Export As. Completed in 15 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate GIMP menus (Colors, File), use Brightness-Contrast dialog with sliders, export images via Export As, handle file overwrite dialogs
metadata.task_rationale: Same Brightness-Contrast dialog but targeting contrast instead of brightness. Tests if model can adjust a different parameter in the same dialog it already proved capable of using.
metadata.explanation: Task asks to increase contrast. Custom getter fetches both original and edited images from VM, computes contrast (std dev of grayscale pixels) and structural similarity (MSE-based). Custom metric checks contrast increased (0.5 score) and structural similarity maintained above threshold (0.5 score). Postconfig exports the edited image as edited_contrast.png for evaluation. [Fixed: replaced cloud_file expected type with rule-based expected using custom getter/metric that fetch both images from VM]

scoring_breakdown.contrast_increase: 0.5 - Contrast of edited image is higher than original
scoring_breakdown.structural_similarity: 0.5 - Edited image maintains structural similarity to original (>= 0.3)

fix_history: Fix 1: Replaced cloud_file expected.type with rule-based expected. Created custom getter (get_contrast_comparison__a61095a992c03ac5e17b282d64e6f2d0) that fetches both original and edited images from VM and computes contrast/similarity metrics. Created custom metric (check_contrast_increase__a61095a992c03ac5e17b282d64e6f2d0) that validates contrast increase and structural similarity using rule-based thresholds.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly measures contrast as standard deviation of grayscale pixel intensities — a valid and standard contrast metric.
Getter properly fetches both original and edited images from VM and computes MSE-based structural similarity to ensure the image wasn't replaced entirely.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' — directly accesses expected.get('min_similarity', 0.3) without incorrectly wrapping in expected['rules'].
Scoring breakdown is sensible: 0.5 for contrast increase + 0.5 for structural similarity maintained, totaling 1.0 for full success.
Coverage is complete for the instruction 'Increase the contrast of my photo' — verifies contrast increased and image identity preserved.

Minor concern: postconfig types 'edited_contrast' without .png extension in GIMP Export As dialog. GIMP may or may not auto-append the extension depending on format selector state, which could cause the getter to fail finding the file at the expected path '/home/user/Desktop/edited_contrast.png'.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider typing the full filename with extension ('edited_contrast.png') in the postconfig pyautogui.write() call to ensure the exported file has the correct .png extension regardless of GIMP dialog state.
